name: Nick Sirianni's Power RPO & Brotherly Shove System
description: A physical, identity-driven offense built on gap power football paired with perimeter RPO access. Nick Sirianni's Eagles combine power duo runs that rely on vertical double-teams, RPO glance and slant reads that punish aggressive linebackers, boundary isolation for elite wide receivers, and the most famous short-yardage play in the NFL — the Brotherly Shove quarterback sneak.
